name: Core
description: Company, branches, warehouses, tills, users, roles, devices, audit, modules, settings, catalog, prices and tax, stock ledger and the POS. Always installed.

permissions.label: Manage company profile, branches, warehouses and tills
View the audit log
Sign in to a POS till by PIN, open/close shifts and sell
View products, units, barcodes and prices
Create and edit products, units, barcodes, categories and brands
Change prices, price lists and tax set-up
View stock levels and movements
Enter opening stock and stock adjustments
View till sales, receipts and shifts
View online orders
Prepare, fulfil and cancel online orders
Set up online stores and sales channels (including their API keys)
Create and edit suppliers and the products they supply
View purchase orders, goods received and supplier prices
Create purchase orders and submit them for approval
Approve purchase orders up to your limit (never your own)
Receive goods (GRN) and put them away into bins
Approve deliveries above the over-delivery tolerance and reverse goods received
Create, dispatch and receive stock transfers
Start stock counts and enter counted quantities
Approve and post stock counts (not your own)
Set up bins and reorder levels
Review and resolve offline and sync exceptions
Run sync, manage sync peers and settings, import/export sync files
View users and their access
Create and edit users, reset PINs
Edit roles and grant or revoke access
Register, enrol and revoke devices
Enable or disable modules per branch
Change system settings
Verify the audit hash chain
